question: How does One-to-One virtual software training work at CACTS?
answer: You get a private virtual classroom with an active developer. Using tools like Google Meet or Zoom, you share your screen to write code live, receiving instant line-by-line feedback and guidance.

question: Why is a 1-to-1 learning model superior to standard batch training?
answer: In typical batches of 30-50 students, the pace is rigid. Our 1-to-1 model lets us adjust the training speed dynamically to match your grasp. We stop, explain, and review whenever you face a bug or conceptual bottleneck.

question: Are the training sessions pre-recorded lectures?
answer: No. Every single session is conducted live in real-time. We do not use pre-recorded video playbacks, ensuring active, two-way interaction at all times.

question: Who are the mentors at CACTS?
answer: All mentors are working software developers and engineers. They work on active commercial projects and bring real industry standards, patterns, and workflows directly to your sessions.

question: What does the Live Project Internship phase involve?
answer: After completing core modules, you join active company git repositories. You will work on real tickets, write production code, submit pull requests, and receive feedback from dev teams.

question: Are these mock or sandbox projects?
answer: No. We do not use dummy exercises or copy-paste templates. You will work on real, live-running application codebases backed by actual companies.

question: Do you provide technical competences or assistance?
answer: No. We do not guarantee jobs or placements. We focus strictly on building high-demand practical skills and giving you real-world project credentials that help you stand out to hiring managers.

question: What is the pricing model, and are there hidden costs?
answer: Our fees are all-inclusive (ranging from ₹7,999 to ₹24,999 depending on the course). There are zero hidden registration, staging server, or certification fees.

question: How long has CACTS been operating in Pune?
answer: CACTS was established in 2012 in Shivane, Pune. For over a decade, we have mentored thousands of students through personalized, one-to-one computer training.
